updated_from.description: Only subscribers updated after this date. Format yyyy-mm-dd.

updated_to.description: Only subscribers updated before this date. Format yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, 50 subscribers per page. Defaults to 1.

sort_order.description: Sort direction. Kit defaults to ascending.

sort_field.description: Set to Cancelled At to list cancelled subscribers, sorted by cancellation date.

kit_list_subscribers.afterResponse:
const page = (v) => { if (v == null || v === '') return 1; const n = Number(v); if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1) throw new Error(`Page must be a whole number of 1 or more, got "${v}".`); return n; };
return { subscribers: response.subscribers ?? [], page: response.page ?? page(inputs.page), total_pages: response.total_pages, total_subscribers: response.total_subscribers };
